name: Particulate Matter (PM2.5)
why_it_matters: Fine particulate matter penetrates deeply into the lungs and bloodstream, driving acute and chronic cardiovascular and respiratory morbidity.

name: Aerosol Optical Depth
why_it_matters: AOD measures total column atmospheric particles, reflecting urban smog accumulation, dust storms, and regional haze.

name: Monthly Rainfall
why_it_matters: Shifts in monsoon and winter rainfall directly determine urban flash flooding, agricultural water security, and drought stress.

name: Nitrogen Dioxide Column
why_it_matters: Tropospheric NO₂ is a primary byproduct of fossil fuel combustion from traffic and thermal power generation, serving as an urban emission tracer.
